assumptions.statement: Carry 80 provisional 1/4-20 deck screws and corresponding field drill/tap operations. Deck plan does not specify spacing/count. This is a priced quantity allowance subject to platform designer's fastening layout; not a verified drawing count. User reply repeated field-drill/tap scope without giving a count.
assumptions.evidence: Signed platform p5, view-8f90517d-1e93-4fb5-ba93-cf919b4a07be; askUser reply 2026-10-07 reiterated scope.
assumptions.impact: Each extra fastening adds adjusted 0.48 drill/tap hours plus 0.05 screw-fitting hours and screw cost.

assumptions.statement: Use activity-level crew-duration allowances for bespoke equipment/platform work: 3 mechanical trades plus one working foreman. Three trades for 4 days platform erection, 1 day stairs/guards, 3 days Servo-Lift assembly, 1 day WP200 setting; two-trade durations for cabinets, valve/chutes, hoses and hookups. Foreman 15 regular days plus matching platform overtime. Hours are person-hours and crew planning is estimator judgment.
assumptions.evidence: Reviewed all three PDFs and equipment-manual production/composite-rate introduction. Library searches found no exact bespoke assembly unit. Rate basis Teva2026D2D(MECH).
assumptions.impact: Base trade hours 390.4 after explicit drill/tap factors; approximately 15 workdays at three trades plus foreman.

assumptions.statement: Field drilling baseline 0.24 person-hours/hole from EPM-019-001-01 (carbon steel <=1/2in, hole<=3/4in). Apply explicit 1.333333 tapping factor from source note and explicit 1.50 stainless drilling/tapping method factor as estimator judgment. Do not apply to unrelated labour.
assumptions.evidence: laborUnit lu-c5d4ae87-b975-445f-a6a3-05ac1895d3eb; dataset ds-91dd7ada-5504-4639-afc2-9097dccc9c5d; source page116. Platform HSS wall3/8in and 1/4-20 deck screws.
assumptions.impact: 80 holes baseline19.2h becomes38.4h; SS multiplier is a priced method assumption.

assumptions.statement: Five platform anchors are verified: five plates x one anchor each. Price the user-specified HAS-R 316SS3/4x9-5/8 rods and HIT-HY500RE11.16USfl oz adhesive exactly as directed. Adhesive procurement uses provisional7/8in concrete bore x6.5in embedment; geometry is estimating basis only. One nominal330mL pack meets five holes with30% waste/purge allowance. Structural embedment, slab suitability and supplier product designation require confirmation before purchase/installation.
assumptions.evidence: platform p4 claims claim-5be53a738b98 / claim-b5dec68253fc; user product directive.
assumptions.impact: Rod5EA; adhesive1EA(pack); no substituted adhesive product priced.

assumptions.statement: No exact Hilti anchor/adhesive, deck screw or epoxy grout price was found in catalogs/cost intelligence. Carry disclosed CAD material budget allowances: platform rods$60EA; adhesive$180/11.16fl oz pack; deck screws$1.50EA; platform epoxy grout$250LS; Servo floor fixing hardware$45EA for8, other fixing hardware$15EA for12; incidental utility fittings$500LS; field drill/tap consumables$250LS.
assumptions.evidence: searchCatalogs Hilti=0; recommendCostSource exact Hilti/epoxy/screws no matching priced SKU; wedge/safety anchor candidates rejected as mismatched.
assumptions.impact: Budget values subject to supplier quotation; preserve specified product and physical quantities.

assumptions.statement: Platform fabrication by others supplies complete knocked-down framing, deck, stairs/guards and erection bolts, including fabricated/welded tapped upper-ASBV mounting plate and lower-ASBV underside plate shown on Servo-Lift drawing. Our work includes assembly/field deck drilling and mechanical bolting; ceiling-support structural modifications stay in$25,000 subcontract allowance. No self-perform fabrication or electrical work.
assumptions.evidence: User commercial direction; Servo RevA p1 view-bba9965a-c0f3-45ab-8d6a-36f2517b838d welded plate notes.
assumptions.impact: Avoid fabrication and room-modification labour double count. Stair foot hardware included in supplier package; additional site design changes excluded.

assumptions.statement: Work area released and ready for regular day shifts; equipment supplied at grade; route available for rental 10,000lb fork truck and8,000lb telehandler. Lift capacity/reach, floor load and ceiling attachment approval precede lifts. Carry fork truck1week, telehandler1week,26ft scissor lift3weeks; rental transport/fuel/waiver budget$1,500LS; no external crane/rigging subcontract.
assumptions.evidence: User rental rigging directive; WP2002050kg and platform elevation8ft6in, Servo ceiling282in.
assumptions.impact: 15-workday mechanical sequence; no room-mod subcontract self-perform hours.

assumptions.statement: All electrical, utility piping/headers before client stub points, equipment procurement, platform fabrication, separate vendor commissioning crew, controls programming, process qualification/validation and engineering design are excluded. Mechanical checkout/turnover is included in foreman supervision; client supplies suitable utility media and first-fill water.
assumptions.evidence: Authoritative user instructions; AW vendor utility requirements.

assumptions.statement: Use 80% regular/20% overtime tier split on platform erection, stairs/guards, platform anchor installation/grouting, deck field drill/tap and screw fitting. No overtime productivity penalty assumed. Foreman covers matching overtime.
assumptions.evidence: Authoritative user instruction about20% platform work hours; Teva2026MECH actual regular/overtime tiers.
assumptions.impact: Rate split only; no extra production hours for overtime.
